name: Ashen Bark [Achievement]
body:
You have been exposed to fire and hardened against it.

Prerequisites: Plant type, Oozing Sap, Must have taken over 100 points of fire damage.

Benefit: You gain fire resistance 5. You also lose any vulnerability to fire you may have had.
